Definition
[Norm on $H^{-1}(U)$] ↗ def:dual-space-h-minus-1 1. ch5:5.9-def-2\group Dual Sobolev Spaces

If $f \in H^{-1}(U)$, we define the norm \[ \| f\| _{H^{-1}(U)} = \sup \left\{ \langle f,u\rangle \mid u \in H_0^1(U), \| u\| _{H_0^1(U)} \le 1\right\} . \]
